sentences.text: Roger Federer -LRB- born 8 August 1981 -RRB- is a Swiss professional tennis player .	tennis	tennis
Many players and analysts have called him the greatest male tennis player of all time .	tennis	tennis
Federer turned professional in 1998 and was continuously ranked in the top 10 from October 2002 to November 2016 .	2002	2002 US Open – Men's Doubles
